description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering a subpanel view of users associated with roles in SuiteCRM, including UI elements and list view setup.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM interface.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new XTemplate with specified template file and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the XTemplate for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text or HTML for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data.
